- DEFI_AUTONOMOUS_MAX_USD — default: 25 — Per-transaction ceiling below which a `defi_trade` verb may execute autonomously; above it `tx_guard` returns `lane=owner_queue` and does NOT execute.
- DEFI_TIERED_SPEND_LANE — default: OFF — An explicit owner-controlled mode. `defi_trade`'s four verbs sit on `PAYMENT_APPROVAL_TOOLS`' SPEND lane, which queues them through `owner_queue` in **every** mode; unattended, that tap never comes and the trade times out.
- X402_AUTONOMOUS_MAX_USD — default: 1.0 — Per-payment ceiling below which an `x402_fetch` skips the owner-approval tap and runs act-and-report.
- DEFI_AUTONOMOUS_TURN_TRADING — default: OFF — narrows `tx_guard`'s turn-origin bar.
